name: Mesha
title: Descendants of Benjamin
summary: Mesha is a person mentioned in the book of Nehemiah as one of the descendants of Benjamin. He is listed in the genealogies of those who settled in Jerusalem after returning from the Babylonian exile. His role was connected to the repopulation of Jerusalem during Persian times.

keyEvents.title: Listed in Benjamin's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Mesha is mentioned as one of the descendants of Benjamin in the genealogies of those who settled in Jerusalem after the exile.

keyEvents.title: Settlement in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Mesha was among those who settled in Jerusalem as part of the rebuilding of the city after returning from Babylon.

keyEvents.title: The Lineage from Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Mesha belonged to the tribe of Benjamin, one of the tribes that returned from exile and settled in the rebuilt Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Rebuilding the Community
keyEvents.description: As part of the tribe of Benjamin, Mesha contributed to the rebuilding of the Jewish community in Jerusalem under Nehemiah's leadership.
